name: com.moderncsharpinunity.simpledependencyinjection
description:
This is a simple dependency injection framework for Unity3D, started as part of a blog to explain how to build your own dependency injection in Unity3D, but now will be evolved and maintained as an independent software.

0.3.0 is a breaking release: the container is async-only (the synchronous ServiceContext/IModule are gone; what was ServiceContextAsync/IModuleAsync lost the "Async" suffix and gained progress reporting + cancellation), field and method injection now share one base-to-derived traversal per class hierarchy (previously only method injection walked base classes, and fields on a base class were silently skipped), GameObjectServiceScope can now self-bootstrap for scene-root usage, GlobalServiceScope.Activate() now correctly parents to the app scope, disposal exists for the first time (ServiceProvider/ServiceContext/every scope), and unresolved/failed injections throw specific exceptions naming the scope, object, member and service involved instead of a bare ArgumentException.

samples.description: Contains sample code and setup for dependency injection
